name: Nature Priest
summary: Nature priests serve two masters: their deities and nature itself, and can call upon the power of both to fuel their divine abilities.
replacesText: Deity; Class Skills; Weapon Proficiencies; Nature Sense; Nature Bond; Resist Nature's Lure; Venom Immunity

features.name: Faithful Deity
features.summary: Choose the deity worshiped by the Nature Priest.

features.name: Faithful Alignment
features.summary: Choose an alignment within one step of the selected deity.

features.name: Class Skills
features.summary: A nature priest adds Knowledge (religion) to her list of class skills instead of Knowledge (geography). This alters the druid’s class skills.

features.name: Weapon Proficiencies
features.summary: A nature priest is proficient with her deity’s favored weapon in addition to a druid’s typical weapon proficiencies. This alters the druid’s weapon proficiencies.

features.name: Studious Piety (Ex)
features.summary: A nature priest gains a +1 bonus on Knowledge (religion) checks. This bonus increases to +2 when attempting checks that involve knowledge of her deity or her faith. This ability replaces nature sense.

features.name: Nature Bond
features.summary: Choose an animal companion or a domain. A selected domain must be granted by the Nature Priest's deity.

features.name: Deity Domain
features.summary: Choose one domain granted by the selected deity.
features.requiredOptionMessage: Choose the Domain nature bond first

features.name: Shepherd of the Faithful (Su)
features.summary: At 4th level, a nature priest and all allies within 60 feet that can see or hear her gain a +2 insight bonus on skill checks to notice or avoid natural hazards, difficult terrain, and rough winds or water, as well as on saving throws against natural hazards. This ability offers no protection against the abilities of creatures or the effects of spells or items. This ability replaces resist nature’s lure.

resourceActions.label: Track Shepherd of the Faithful

confirmations.label: The check or save concerns a natural hazard, difficult terrain, or rough wind or water—not a creature, spell, or item

activeEffect.name: Shepherd of the Faithful
activeEffect.description: Self and allies within 60 feet who can see or hear the Nature Priest gain +2 insight on qualifying checks and saves.

resourceActions.summary: Track the conditional 60-foot aura for a qualifying natural hazard.

features.name: Divine Servants (Su)
features.summary: At 9th level, a nature priest adds the spells lesser planar ally, planar ally, and greater planar ally to her druid spell list at their cleric spell levels. When she casts these spells, the planar allies summoned require half the payment described in those spells. This ability replaces the venom immunity ability.

numericCalculations.label: Divine Servants payment
numericCalculations.summary: The result is half the normal payment, rounded down if necessary.

mechanicalNotes: Deity and one-step alignment legality, custom favored-weapon proficiency, animal-or-deity-domain Nature Bond, deity-filtered domain choices and slots, class skills, Studious Piety, both Shepherd hazard bonuses, all three planar ally additions, and exact half-payment calculation are automated.

skillBonusAdjustments.condition: +2 total when the check concerns the Nature Priest's deity or faith

conditionalModifiers.label: Shepherd of the Faithful — checks
conditionalModifiers.condition: Self and allies within 60 feet that can see or hear the Nature Priest: skill checks to notice or avoid natural hazards, difficult terrain, or rough wind or water

conditionalModifiers.label: Shepherd of the Faithful — saves
conditionalModifiers.condition: Self and allies within 60 feet that can see or hear the Nature Priest: saving throws against natural hazards
